backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the NFT marketplace backend with collections, NFT items, user profiles, and ICRC-7 token minting; includes admin/user access control via MixinAuthorization and blob storage via MixinStorage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two features—fixing the Admin Dashboard infinite loading state and ensuring the backend actor uses the authenticated identity—to their respective files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, components, and hooks for the NFT art portfolio application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light art portfolio app, setting German language, viewport meta, title, and mounting the React app at #root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (gallery, artwork, upload, blog, NFT gallery/detail, admin) wrapped in a dark-mode ThemeProvider and Layout.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for creating or editing NFT collections in the admin dashboard, using useCreateCollection/useUpdateCollection hooks with validation, error display, and German-language toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Displays a list of NFT collections with edit and delete actions, using a confirmation dialog for deletion and a modal dialog for editing via AdminCollectionForm.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing an NFT item, handling image upload with progress, collection selection, price input, and calling create/update mutation hooks on submit.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Renders a list of all NFTs with thumbnail, collection name, price badge, and per-item edit/delete actions including a confirmation dialog for deletion.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Presentational card component that displays a legacy artwork's image, title, and description with hover scale and overlay effects.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Card component for a minted on-chain NFT showing its image, token ID, mint date, owner principal, and optional 'Mein NFT' highlight badge when owned by the current user.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component providing a sticky header with logo, navigation, and login button, a main content slot, and a footer with copyright and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing a spinner during authentication and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for minting NFTs on ICP, handling image upload (with drag-and-drop), title/description input, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top-level navigation bar component that renders route buttons for Home, NFT Gallery, Blog, Contact, and conditionally Upload and Admin links based on authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component that displays a sparkle icon and 'NFT' label using the primary color scheme.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component that displays an NFT's image, title, collection name, price in ICP, and an optional link to the ICP explorer.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A clickable card component linking to an external NFT marketplace (Getgems), showing a collection's image, title, and description with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a static grid of seven predefined NFT collections (Getgems/TON blockchain) using NFTCollectionCard.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A detail modal for an NFT showing its image, metadata (title, description, token ID, mint date, owner, price), and copyable fields with an ICP explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting, and ICP architecture to educate users about the technology.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: React component that displays NFT metadata (token ID, mint date, price) and a link to the ICP Explorer, with helper functions to format timestamps and prices.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Reusable component that displays an ICP principal address (optionally shortened) with a tooltip showing the full value and a copy-to-clipboard button.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Defines a StaticBlogPost interface and exports an array of static German-language blog posts about light health topics (wavelengths, blue light, red light) with hardcoded content and relative timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing it when the Internet Identity changes and invalidating dependent queries accordingly.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been removed in favor of the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls the backend actor's addCollection method and invalidates the nft-collections query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that calls addNFT on the backend actor, then fetches and returns the newly created NFT, with user-friendly error parsing for authorization failures.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes a collection by ID via the backend actor and invalidates both nft-collections and nft-items queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID via the backend actor and invalidates the nft-items query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old artwork backend which has been superseded by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array for backend blog posts, allowing static blog posts to remain functional.
Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor, with loading state combining actor and query loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: Query hook that fetches all issued ICRC-7 NFTs from the backend actor via listAllNFTs.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches all NFT items from the backend actor via getAllNFTs.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns null, replacing the old single-artwork fetch from the deprecated artwork backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old category-filtered artwork fetch from the deprecated artwork backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns null for a single blog post, deferring to static posts instead.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend, only enabled when the user is logged in and the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches the authenticated user's own issued NFTs via listMyNFTs, enabled only when authenticated.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: Query hook that fetches a single NFT item by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: Query hook that fetches all NFT items belonging to a specific collection ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity state management using DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks whether the currently authenticated caller is an admin by calling the backend actor's `isCallerAdmin` method.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdminWithT: Hook that checks admin status with a configurable overall timeout, handling actor-wait and admin-check phases, and exposing retry, error, and timedOut states.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that mints a new NFT via the backend actor and invalidates related query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile via the backend actor and invalidates the current user profile query on success.
Stub mutation hook for a contact form that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT collection's name and description via the backend actor and invalidates the collections query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT's metadata and image via the backend actor and invalidates the NFT items query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook for artwork upload that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Hook that handles image file validation, upload progress tracking, and uploading to the backend actor, returning an ExternalBlob on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a warm art-themed light and dark color palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that gates access by authentication and admin status, displaying collection and NFT management tabs with loading, timeout, and error states.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: A placeholder page for artwork details that no longer functions since the old artwork backend was replaced by the NFT system. It simply displays a 'not found' message with a back button to the gallery.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Displays a list of blog posts by merging static light-health posts with backend posts, supporting navigation to individual posts. Admins with an Internet Identity can navigate to create a new post.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: A form page for admin users to create new blog posts with a title, content, and optional featured image upload. Redirects non-admins back to the blog and submits data via the useCreateBlogPost hook.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Renders a single blog post by ID, checking both static light-health posts and backend data. Displays the title, publication date, optional featured image, and full content.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: A contact form page with name, email, subject, and message fields that submits via the useSubmitContactForm hook. Includes client-side validation and displays success or error alerts.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: The main gallery page featuring a hero banner, a static quote, and NFT collections loaded from the backend. Shows loading skeletons while fetching and an error state with a retry button on failure.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single NFT including its image, title, description, collection badge, price, and a link to the ICP dashboard. Fetches NFT data by ID and resolves its collection from the full collections list.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: React page displaying an NFT gallery with tabs for all NFTs, issued NFTs, and user-owned NFTs, supporting collection filtering, minting via modal, and detail view. Requires Internet Identity authentication for minting and shows wallet/principal info.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: React page providing a form to upload and mint a new NFT with title, description, price, collection selection, and image upload with progress tracking. Requires authentication and navigates to the gallery on success.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions for merging static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, finding a post by ID from either source, and formatting timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Async utility that copies a string to the clipboard using the modern Clipboard API with a fallback to the legacy execCommand approach for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility functions to shorten a principal string with ellipsis and to format it for display either in full or shortened form.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing sensitive parameters from the URL hash without reloading.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended font families (Inter, Playfair Display), border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations including accordion and fade-in effects.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a fix request to resolve the Admin Dashboard's infinite loading state after Internet Identity login, caused by a race condition in the admin authentication check and actor instantiation timing.
